page.title: Comics
emptyHint: Add an episode and a page, then bring your story to life with the assistant.
imageEmpty: Describe the scene, style and dialogue in the assistant. It will generate a complete comic page.
prompt: Describe a complete page or request a change to the image, dialogue or character
libraryEmpty: The library is empty. Add characters, scenes and styles in the shared library.
errors.INVALID_ARGUMENT: Invalid input. Check the page, image or selection.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Limit exceeded: 12 references, 32 MiB of images and 32 KiB of reference descriptions.
errors.NOT_FOUND: Content is unavailable. Reopen this page.
errors.UNSUPPORTED: This model or file format does not support the operation. Check model settings.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This command has different input. Start a new edit.
errors.DOCUMENT_CONFLICT: This page changed. Reopen it before retrying; saved images are retained.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Required permission is missing. Check permissions in Extensions.
errors.NOT_CONFIGURED: Select an available image model in the canvas toolbar.
errors.INTERRUPTED: The request stopped or was interrupted. Saved images remain available; start a new generation to retry.
errors.RUNTIME_FAILED: Creation did not complete. Check the model connection and retry. Saved content remains available.
outlineEmpty: Organize your story into episodes and create it page by page.
historyHint: Every edit preserves the original. Preview any version and adopt it as the current page.
name: Name
referenceHint: Upload reference images or select shared Project material. The next generation or edit uses these references.
dialoguePrompt: Change the character’s dialogue to “”, keeping everything else unchanged.
characterPrompt: Update the character using the reference images, preserving composition, story and dialogue.
planPrompt: Help me plan this episode and its pages. Let’s discuss the story before generating images.
renameHint: Change the episode name, or leave it blank to use its number. Pages are always numbered by position.
trashHint: Deleted episodes and pages stay here with their artwork and version history. Restore them at any time.
sortHint: Drag a row to reorder, or long-press and drag on touch screens. Press Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space to drop, and Escape to cancel.
imageModelsEmpty: No image models available. Configure one in Denova settings.
imageModelMissing: The selected model is unavailable. Choose another model.
